figurative_meaning_en: Extremely busy; very anxious or flustered
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষার আগে সে ব্যতিব্যস্ত হয়ে উঠল।
example_sentences_in_english: She became vyativyasta before the exam.
Everyone is vyativyasta due to work pressure.
note: This idiom emphasizes a state of heightened busyness or agitation common in Bengali expressive language.
